evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The question is how well such process-level managerial decisions are supported by existing approaches, given that PPM research has so far not focused on process-level predictions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Notably, aggregated trace-level predictions cause errors to compound on process-level, reducing accuracy and highlighting process-level prediction as a distinct predictive task that warrants dedicated research.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across synthetic and real-life event logs, we compare statistical and machine-learning-based methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and, importantly, established trace-level PPM approaches, aggregating their predictions to the process-level.
